text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-c-o-n-n-e-c-t-e-d e-s-s-e-n-t-i-a-l u-t-i-l-i-t-y s-e-r-v-i-c-e-s, l-e-f-t b-i-l-l-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d s-h-o-w-i-n-g i-l-l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e s-h-u-t-o-f-f s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d o-c-c-u-p-a-n-c-y h-a-b-i-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d t-h-e l-o-c-k m-e-c-h-a-n-i-s-m s w-i-t-h-o-u-t a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g k-e-y a-c-c-e-s s l-o-g s t-r-a-c-e s o-f u-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d e-n-t-r-y, a-n-d o-m-i-t-t-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y l-e-g-a-l e-v-i-c-t-i-o-n c-l-e-a-r-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d w-r-i-t-t-e-n w-a-r-n-i-n-g n-o-t-i-c-e s, d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g t-h-r-e-a-t e-n-g-u-a-g-e i-n a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d c-o-p-i-e-s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e n-e-e-d e-d l-e-g-a-l c-o-u-n-s-e-l r-e-v-i-e-w o-f a-d-v-e-r-s-e m-e-s-s-a-g-e s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-g-r-a-d-e-d t-h-e p-r-e-m-i-s-e s c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n g p-h-o-t-o g-r-a-p-h i-c p-r-o-o-f o-f s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-a l d-a-m-a g-e, a-n-d n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d h-e-a-l-t-h a-n-d s-a-f-e-t y i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o l.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d t-o e-v-a-d-e h-o-u-s-i-n g o-v-e-r-s-i-g-h-t, f-a-i-l-i-n g t-o l-o-g i-n-s-p-e-c-t-o r i-n-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c e d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-t-e-p.
